title: incident-bot: integrate slo-toolkit diagnostic helpers into on-call workflow and runbook linking
author: Ravi Menon
release_notes: Enhances incident-bot with SLO toolkit diagnostic helpers: better runbook linking, prioritized diagnostic hints, and lightweight telemetry for on-call context. No customer-facing API changes.
description:
Motivation: On-call engineers repeatedly ask for better SLO context and prioritized diagnostic hints when an SLO alert fires. This PR integrates helpers from the slo-toolkit into incident-bot so runbook linking, SLO hint generation, and diagnostic quicklinks are surfaced directly in channel notifications and the /oncall summary flow.

What this changes: Adds a new slo_diagnostics helper module that: 1) looks up correlated SLOs for a given alert key, 2) ranks runbook links by recent success and relevance, 3) emits compact diagnostic hints (top 3) and recommended quicklinks for remediation. Changes the oncall-summary and runbook-linking handlers to call the helper and include its output in the message payload. Adds feature flag slo_toolkit_oncall_diagnostics gated by a rollout config.

Implementation notes and scope: - New modules: incident_bot/slo_diagnostics.py and incident_bot/handlers/oncall_diagnostics.py - Minor schema additions to notification payloads (compact fields only) and JSON serialization helpers. - Lightweight telemetry: emits slo.diagnostics.generated and slo.runbook.rank metrics with tags for alert_key and team. - Feature-flagged behind rollout config to allow canary.

Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for ranking heuristics and hint formatting - [x] Integration test for oncall-summary message generation - [x] Feature flag and rollout config in place - [x] Telemetry emitted and documented - [x] Docs snippet added to runbook linking section in README

Testing and QA: Ran local integration against staging SLO dataset, exercised runbook linking across 3 teams. CI had one flaky test during first run (test_runbook_cache_eviction) which was fixed by stabilizing the cache TTL logic and re-run. Load smoke test: created 200 synthetic alerts and validated < 300ms added latency per alert when helper is enabled.

Backwards compatibility: The message payload additions are optional and consumed only by the new handlers; existing consumers ignore them. No breaking changes expected.

Rollout plan: Enable slo_toolkit_oncall_diagnostics for a single infra SRE team for 48h, monitor slo.diagnostics.* metrics and oncall-channel error rates, then progressively enable across teams.
